verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. The only adjacent signals are a 'v1/openapi.yaml' path in the OpenAPI repo, a feature changelog, and Classic-to-Billing migration guides. None of these establishes versioned API contracts with documented deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
